title: queryHook is broken
body:
**Describe the bug 🐛**

The option `queryHook` on `SearchBox` is broken since the version [3.2.0](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/develop/CHANGELOG.md#320-2019-03-14). The widget is not updated correctly, stalled data override the latest keystrokes. I've tested with version 3.1.1 and we don't have the issue, it made me think that the `SearchBox` rewrite is the problem.

**To Reproduce 🔍**

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Go to https://codesandbox.io/s/instantsearchjs-queryhook-issue-n04f7
2. Enable the network throttling
3. Type into the `SearchBox`
4. After some delay the latest character are overridden

Without the network throttling, the issue is present too. But it's easier to reproduce with it.
